content_text:
Hi all, I’m looking for pdf files from Stephen Murphy blog but apparently it has expired
I’ve only managed to find Januz Kamniski’s case study from this website
Download This Cinematography Case Study of Janusz Kaminski, ASC
I wonder anyone still keeps the pdf files, would be super if you’re able to share it here 🙂
Thank you
Best regards,
Bernard Lim
